name: strategy-gate
task: Validate the active strategy profile, readiness, and preflight route before switching the VPS swarm to a new strategy.

validator.command: bash -lc 'node -e "const path = require(\"path\"); const { getEngineState } = require(path.join(process.cwd(), \"scripts\", \"engine_state_store.js\")); const state = getEngineState(\"strategy-gate\"); if (state && state.state === \"armed\") { console.log(\"STRATEGY_GATE_PASSED\"); process.exit(0); } process.exit(1);"'
